name: Julie
source:
A charming young workaholic who is always trying her best to make others happy. 

She has few friends and struggles to understand what makes her happy outside of the purpose that school used to give her and work currently gives her.

Her work forces her to take two weeks vacation due to all of the unused vacation time she has accrued. 

During her vacation, she accidently clicks on a pop-up that claims to have a program to help her better understand herself. 

She is intrigued by this and registers for the program. 

This enrolment ends up placing her on a dark path, beyond anything she could have expected....
